ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/entries/catego: An ancient wizard more concerned with the question of if he could not if he should created the Arcane Applicator. The device can store a Runic Stone of Storage, a Scroll of Save Starbuncle, a Scroll of Spell Transfer or an inscribed Spell Parchment and apply it to surrounding machinery when it receives a redstone signal.

It applies the stored configurations to all Spellturrets (for Scrolls) and relays (for Runic Stones) right next to it. The Scroll of Save Starbuncle will be applied to all Starbuncles in a 10 block radius that are bound to a bed right next to the Arcane Applicator

Rightclick a configured Source Relay of any type with the Runic Stone of Storage to store it's configuration. Shift-Rightclick a Source Relay to apply a stored configuration. For Splitter-Type Relays this ADDS to the already applied configuration. Standard Relay Configuration is overwritten. To clear a stored configuration, craft the Runic Stone of Storage.

Rightclick a Starbuncle with a Scroll of Save Starbuncle to save its current configuration to the Scroll. Shift-Rightclick a Starbuncle to apply the stored configuration. Shift-Rightclick empty air to clear the currently stored configuration.

The Scroll of Spelltransfer can be inscribed on the Scribe's Table and will hold one spell. Shift-Rightclicking while holding the Scroll of Spelltransfer in your main hand and a spellbook in the offhand will apply the inscribed spell to the currently selected spellslot of the book.
A wise mage noted that he could extract the essence of his vanquished foes and imbue a massive chunk of diamond with it.
For the mage that just needs every bit of data, the Numeric Mana Charm adds a numeric mana indicator while worn in the charm slot
Magical Armor can be transformed in the Enchanting Appartus. It will keep all previously applied enchantments.

A wizard is always prepared for all eventualities. With the Wizards Armarium your wardrobe travels with you and allows you to switch between 3 different Armor and Hotbar configurations. The Item Hotbar Switch can be toggled via shift-rightclicking with the Armarium. This will drop all stored items to the ground.
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/categories/tom: Blood Magic integration for Ars Nouveau. Adds  interoperability between $(thing)Blood Magic$() and $(thing)Ars Nouveau$().
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/entries/tomeof: Heretic's Armor is an upgrade of Blood Magic's Living Armor. It combines the abilities of Blood Magic's Living Armor and Ars Nouveau's Magical Armor. $(br2) It has access to both Magical Perks and Living Upgrades.
It also has access to Living upgrade points on the chestplate!
This upgrades gives you Mana discount upto 20%% (5%% per level). $(br2)Trained by: Casting spells and consuming Mana $(br2)Max Level: 4
Level 1: 4 upgrade points $(br)Level 2: 10 upgrade points $(br)Level 3: 22 upgrade points $(br)Level 4: 40 upgrade points $(br)
$(o)Slightly toxic ....$() $(br2)This item grants you $(9)Serene$() potion effect which grants you 10%% bonus blood when self-sacrificing in a blood altar. $(br2) $(o) Has 5%% chance to turn toxic$()

Tome of Blood is a special variant of Ars Nouveau spellbook. They have a connection to the user's $(#880808)Soul Network$(). $(br)They have a special ability where they let you break through Mana cost limits of spells!

The tome will try to cast spells using player mana. $(br2) If the player doesn't have enough mana to cast the spell, it will try to use player's LP to compensate for the remaining spell cost at the rate of 10 LP per mana point

A Tome of Blood can be crafted using some amount of blood in a blood altar. Higher tier spellbooks can be converted to Tomes in the same fashion. The tomes can upgraded in an Alchemy Table (Check JEI).
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/categories/ars: Occultism integration for Ars Nouveau. Adds compatibility and interoperability between $(thing)Occultism$() and $(thing)Ars Nouveau$() and many QoL changes.
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/entries/gem.js: Alternate recipe when diamonds are scarce.
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/entries/spirit: Occultism Spirits can work inside $(l:machines/mob_jar)Containment Jars$(/l). They maintain their original behaviour and $(thing)do not decay$() making them perfect from automations! $(br2)Spirit Jar will automatically pickup any item in 7x7 centered around it that matches spirit's filter (for crushing spirits, it will automatically pickup any ore that it can process).

Items can also be pushed into the containment jar using a hopper or starbuncles (any pipe should also work!). Players can also right-click any item directly on the jar. $(br2)Spirits in Jars exhibit their default behaviour, this means that a $(thing)Crusher Spirit$() will automatically process and fling the output in one of directions
Janitor Spirits inside jars have a special property. They automatically try to pickup items nearby and push to inventory next to it. This makes automation super easy!
ars_nouveau/worn_notebook/entries/transm: You can convert surplus amounts of silver into gold and vice-vera!
bobsoriginiumdream/bobbook/entries/oricr: 可以在丛林低概率刷新，会吃掉一切生物，吃掉僵尸会固定掉落铁，吃掉末影人会固定掉落珍珠，$(br)在食用$(#ff0000)恶水源石虫$()后会呕吐并得到呕吐物
可以在暴食水道（gluttonywaterway）的井盖生成，井盖可以用镐子挖掘后带走，来让食虫花可以吃到恶水源石虫
在源石荒芜之地生成，$(br)在食用$(#ff0000)攻击会极大程度腐蚀护甲$()，需要格外注意
bobsoriginiumdream/bobbook/entries/oridi: 这个手环可以固定你的矿石病指数，例如你的矿石病指数在100-150之间，他会将你的指数固定为125，同时会给你一个buff，让你免除由于矿石病受到的额外伤害
bobsoriginiumdream/bobbook/entries/orish: 你可以去源石荒芜之地找到裸露的源石晶簇，一般生成于恶地附近，可以使用locate指令搜索oridesert，或者是探索一些本模组的结构也会找到源石碎片
源石具有感染性！源石核心会随着时间生长，一些源石怪也会留下源石核心，，一定要记得及时清理，但在清理前我建议你看完整本手册！，你可以按手册接下来教程或者$(#ff0000)奴役女仆或服务器其他玩家$()来安全获得源石
